sources.sourceReview: Reviewed all 288 selected original camera frames on 12 contact sheets and 24 full-resolution OTB-target overlays before any145 tracking prediction. Basketball target is the central green-uniform player; nearby defenders partially overlap early. Girl2 target wears yellow/green and pink; climbs steps carrying a scooter. No complete target disappearance in either fixed evaluation window. Visibility describes external target geometry; external rectangles are retained unchanged even where they omit extremities. Competitor boxes are manually marked visible extents at 12 Basketball and five Girl2 frames (not exhaustive, no interpolation). All identities are benchmark subject declarations, not semantic recognition. External geometry plus attributed AI visibility/competitor review is not independent human adjudication. These camera windows cannot qualify full-occlusion recovery; no easier substitute/window is selected.
limitations: Bounded source windows, not a full benchmark.
External geometry and AI source-only visibility/competitor review, not independent human adjudication.
Generated occlusion and copy controls are separate from real-camera evidence.
Same-object declaration is not semantic identity proof; partial geometry remains inferred.
